title: Does this mean I don't need to learn Blender anymore?
author: Original_Apple_9970
selftext:
I've been thinking about learning Blender for a long time. I've always wanted to create "my own world",cuz my dream is all about zobies robots and stuff like that,it would be fun if i turn them into a open-world game. so learning 3D modeling is a way to make that happen.  
But lately I've been seeing so many AI tools like V2Fun and others, and some of them look pretty impressive.but i'm still a beginner and not so good at it,  
So I'm wondering if these tools actually good enough for what I want to do? Or should I still learn the basics of Blender first? I'm not trying to become a professional 3D artist, I just want to be able to turn the things in my head into something real.

comments.author: bebopbraunbaer
comments.body: In my Experience it rly depends on what you are doing , if you are using classic humanoid figures , architecture , forms that already have been done thousands of times , ai alone can get you very far . You want something outside of the norm ? Ai can guide you and help you learn

comments.author: daddy_reloaded
comments.body:
If you start now, you definitely have to learn some stuff. In some (don't know how many) years, probably not. 
Currently AI can spend hours to fix something I can do better in 10 seconds. 
It move to all manual to 80% of the work done by the AI, and tomorrow no doubt I won't open blender anymore.
